rubrics.justification: Describes a well-expanded Day 5 blastocyst with thinned zona, visible compact ICM, and fairly continuous TE, which is broadly consistent with the provided 3AA grading; minor uncertainty and some hedging about stage 3 vs 4 prevent a top score.

Integrates key factors well: young age, first cycle, semen parameters, AMH/FSH, BMI, endometriosis, smoking, and thin endometrium, and relates them to prognosis; could be more explicit about how endometriosis and lining interact with transfer strategy.

Overall logic is understandable, but there are inconsistencies in implantation estimates (35-45%, 28-42%, 30-45%, 25-40%) and some speculative discussion about freeze-all/progesterone without supporting data.

Contains notable deviations from guideline-consistent practice, especially suggesting double embryo transfer might be worth discussing in a 29-year-old with a good-quality Day 5 blastocyst; also includes questionable phrasing around smoking cessation timing and speculative freeze-all rationale.

Provides some practical suggestions such as single embryo transfer, luteal support, smoking cessation, and considering cavity/protocol review if unsuccessful, but recommendations are somewhat diffuse and not tightly prioritized for this specific case.
